description: Estimate how much better Ophis quotes than the open market for a sell: fetches the Ophis orderbook sell-quote and a public all-DEX aggregator (KyberSwap) quote for the same input, and returns `beatBps` (+ = Ophis returns more of the buy token). Use before build_order to show the expected edge. The reference can reflect thin or manipulated liquidity, so treat beatBps as advisory, not a sole execution signal. Sell-side (exact-in) only. Read-only.

chainId.description: EVM chain id (use a chainId from list_chains `tradeable`).

from.description: The trading account address (quotes are account-aware).

sellAmount.description: Exact sell amount in atoms (uint256 decimal string).

name: expected_surplus
